atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilLen = input(60, "Coil Length", 20, 120, 1)
rangeLen = input(20, "Range Length", 5, 100, 1)
vovLen = input(20, "Vol-of-Vol Length", 5, 60, 1)
predLen = input(20, "Predictability Length", 5, 60, 1)
coilThresh = input(80, "Coil Threshold", 50, 95, 1)
predThresh = input(55, "Predictability Threshold", 10, 90, 1)
releaseMult = input(1.5, "Release Multiplier", 1.1, 3.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

tr1 = high - low
tr2 = abs(high - close[1])
tr3 = abs(low - close[1])
trueRange = max(tr1, tr2)
trueRange2 = max(trueRange, tr3)
atrVal = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
rng = high - low
rangeAvg = sma(rng, rangeLen)
atrLowest = lowest(atrVal, coilLen)
atrHighest = highest(atrVal, coilLen)
coilDenom = max(atrHighest - atrLowest, 0.000000001)
coilLoad = 100 * (atrHighest - atrVal) / coilDenom
rngHighest = highest(rng, coilLen)
rngLowest = lowest(rng, coilLen)
rangeDenom = max(rngHighest - rngLowest, 0.000000001)
rangeCoil = 100 * (rngHighest - rangeAvg) / rangeDenom
loadedCoil = (coilLoad + rangeCoil) / 2
atrAvgVov = sma(atrVal, vovLen)
vovDenom = max(atrAvgVov, 0.000000001)
volOfVol = stdev(atrVal, vovLen) / vovDenom * 100
vovLowest = lowest(volOfVol, coilLen)
volRising = volOfVol > vovLowest + 1.0
tapeMove = close - close[1]
absMove = abs(tapeMove)
moveSum = sma(absMove, predLen) * predLen
moveSumSafe = max(moveSum, 0.000000001)
netMove = abs(close - close[predLen])
predictability = 100 * netMove / moveSumSafe
armed = loadedCoil > coilThresh and volRising
relLongRaw = armed and close > high[1] and rng > rangeAvg * releaseMult
relShortRaw = armed and close < low[1] and rng > rangeAvg * releaseMult
releaseLong = relLongRaw and not relLongRaw[1]
releaseShort = relShortRaw and not relShortRaw[1]
predLong = releaseLong and predictability > predThresh
predShort = releaseShort and predictability > predThresh
anyRelease = releaseLong or releaseShort
anyPred = predLong or predShort

if releaseLong and not anyPred { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Release Long", "triangleup", "#22cc88") }
if releaseShort and not anyPred { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Release Short", "triangledown", "#ff4477") }
if predLong { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Predictable Long", "triangleup", "#00ffcc") }
if predShort { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Predictable Short", "triangledown", "#ff00aa") }
if releaseLong { plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Release Long", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "separate") }
if releaseShort { plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Release Short", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 0, "separate") }
if predLong { plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Predictable Long", "coneup", "#00ffcc", markerSize * 1.5, 1, "separate") }
if predShort { plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Predictable Short", "conedown", "#ff00aa", markerSize * 1.5, 1, "separate") }
if armed { bgcolor("#1a2b4a") }

plot(loadedCoil, "LoadedCoil", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
plot(predictability, "Predictability", "#b48cff", 1, "separate")
hline(coilThresh, "#ffd43b", "separate")
hline(predThresh, "#ff9ff3", "separate")
plot3d(loadedCoil, "Loaded Coil", "bars3d", "#22aaff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(predictability, "Predictability", "surface", "#b48cff", "separate", 1)

SessionLength = input(20, "Session Length", 10, 100, 1)
HtfMins = input(60, "HTF Timeframe (min)", 15, 240, 15)
StructureLookback = input(3, "Structure Lookback", 1, 10, 1)
MinDisplacement = input(0.2, "Min Displacement %", 0.05, 2.0, 0.05)
MinConfidence = input(60, "Min Confidence", 0, 100, 1)
StopOffsetTicks = input(2, "Stop Offset Ticks", 0, 20, 1)

sessHigh = highest(high, SessionLength)
sessLow = lowest(low, SessionLength)
rangeMid = (sessHigh + sessLow) / 2

htfClose = security("1h", close)
htfHigh = security("1h", high)
htfLow = security("1h", low)

htfSwingHigh = highest(htfHigh, StructureLookback)
htfSwingLow = lowest(htfLow, StructureLookback)
priorSwingHigh = htfSwingHigh[1]
priorSwingLow = htfSwingLow[1]

lowsRising = htfSwingLow > htfSwingLow[1]
highsRising = htfSwingHigh > htfSwingHigh[1]
lowsFalling = htfSwingLow < htfSwingLow[1]
highsFalling = htfSwingHigh < htfSwingHigh[1]

bullBreak = htfClose > priorSwingHigh
bearBreak = htfClose < priorSwingLow
bullStructure = bullBreak and (lowsRising or highsRising)
bearStructure = bearBreak and (lowsFalling or highsFalling)
neutralHtf = not bullStructure and not bearStructure

dispUp = priorSwingHigh > 0 ? (htfClose - priorSwingHigh) / priorSwingHigh * 100 : 0
dispDown = priorSwingLow > 0 ? (priorSwingLow - htfClose) / priorSwingLow * 100 : 0
dispUpCapped = min(dispUp / MinDisplacement, 1)
dispDownCapped = min(dispDown / MinDisplacement, 1)

cleanBull = bullStructure and lowsRising and highsRising
cleanBear = bearStructure and lowsFalling and highsFalling
mixedBull = bullStructure and not cleanBull
mixedBear = bearStructure and not cleanBear

structDirBull = cleanBull ? 1 : mixedBull ? 0.5 : 0
structDirBear = cleanBear ? 1 : mixedBear ? 0.5 : 0
structDir = bullStructure ? structDirBull : bearStructure ? structDirBear : 0
dispNorm = bullStructure ? dispUpCapped : bearStructure ? dispDownCapped : 0
dispNormClip = dispNorm < 0 ? 0 : dispNorm > 1 ? 1 : dispNorm
confidence = 50 + 25 * structDir + 25 * dispNormClip
confidenceClip = confidence < 0 ? 0 : confidence > 100 ? 100 : confidence

tickVal = close * 0.0001
longStop = sessLow - StopOffsetTicks * tickVal
shortStop = sessHigh + StopOffsetTicks * tickVal

var pos = 0
breakAbove = crossover(close, sessHigh[1])
breakBelow = crossunder(close, sessLow[1])
breakBelowMid = crossunder(close, rangeMid)
breakAboveMid = crossover(close, rangeMid)
touchLongStop = low <= longStop
touchShortStop = high >= shortStop

canLong = pos == 0 and breakAbove and bullStructure and confidenceClip >= MinConfidence
canShort = pos == 0 and breakBelow and bearStructure and confidenceClip >= MinConfidence
exitLongSig = pos == 1 and (breakBelowMid or touchLongStop or bearStructure)
exitShortSig = pos == -1 and (breakAboveMid or touchShortStop or bullStructure)

if canLong {
    model.confidence(confidenceClip / 100)
    model.stopLoss(close - longStop, "abs")
    model.longEntry("LongSiege")
    pos := 1
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if canShort {
    model.confidence(confidenceClip / 100)
    model.stopLoss(shortStop - close, "abs")
    model.shortEntry("ShortSiege")
    pos := -1
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if exitLongSig {
    model.longExit("LongSiege")
    pos := 0
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Exit Long", "x", "#ffcc33")
}
if exitShortSig {
    model.shortExit("ShortSiege")
    pos := 0
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Exit Short", "x", "#ffcc33")
}

activeStop = pos == 1 ? longStop : pos == -1 ? shortStop : rangeMid
plot(sessHigh, "Session High", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(sessLow, "Session Low", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
plot(activeStop, "Hard Stop", "#ffcc33", 1, "stepline")

volLength = input(14, "Vol Length", 5, 30, 1)
momentumLength = input(12, "Momentum Length", 5, 30, 1)
breakoutLength = input(20, "Breakout Length", 5, 50, 1)
multiplier = input(1.0, "Multiplier", 0.1, 3.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

volRange = highest(high, volLength) - lowest(low, volLength)
volRatio = volRange / close
momVal = close - close[momentumLength]
momThresh = volRatio * close * multiplier
upperBreak = highest(high, breakoutLength)[1]
lowerBreak = lowest(low, breakoutLength)[1]
momUpperBand = close + momThresh
momLowerBand = close - momThresh

buyState = close > upperBreak and momVal > momThresh
sellState = close < lowerBreak and momVal < 0 - momThresh
buySig = buyState and not buyState[1]
sellSig = sellState and not sellState[1]

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if buySig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "3d")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "3d")
}

plot(upperBreak, "Upper Breakout", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(lowerBreak, "Lower Breakout", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
plot(momUpperBand, "Mom Upper Band", "#888888", 1, "line")
plot(momLowerBand, "Mom Lower Band", "#888888", 1, "line")
plot3d(upperBreak, "Upper 3D", "line3d", "#ff4477", "3d", 0)
plot3d(lowerBreak, "Lower 3D", "line3d", "#22cc88", "3d", 1)

lookback = input(80, "Lookback Length", 10, 300, 1)
fib1Pct = input(23.6, "Fib Level 1 %", 1.0, 90.0, 0.1)
fib2Pct = input(38.2, "Fib Level 2 %", 1.0, 90.0, 0.1)
fib3Pct = input(50.0, "Fib Level 3 %", 1.0, 90.0, 0.1)
fib4Pct = input(61.8, "Fib Level 4 %", 1.0, 90.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

swingHigh = highest(high, lookback)
swingLow = lowest(low, lookback)
rng = swingHigh - swingLow

fib236 = swingHigh - rng * fib1Pct / 100
fib382 = swingHigh - rng * fib2Pct / 100
fib50 = swingHigh - rng * fib3Pct / 100
fib618 = swingHigh - rng * fib4Pct / 100

buySig = crossover(close, fib618)
sellSig = crossunder(close, fib382)

buyNow = barstate.isconfirmed and buySig
sellNow = barstate.isconfirmed and sellSig

if buyNow {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Reclaim 61.8%", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Reclaim 61.8%", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 3, "3d")
    text.new(bar_index, low, "Reclaim 61.8%", "#22cc88", 1, "fibEvent")
}
if sellNow {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Loss 38.2%", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Loss 38.2%", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "3d")
    text.new(bar_index, high, "Loss 38.2%", "#ff4477", 1, "fibEvent")
}

plot(fib236, "23.6%", "#00ccff", 1, "stepline")
plot(fib382, "38.2%", "#ffcc00", 1, "stepline")
plot(fib50, "50%", "#b48cff", 1, "stepline")
plot(fib618, "61.8%", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")

plot3d(fib236, "Fib 23.6%", "line3d", "#00ccff", "3d", 0)
plot3d(fib382, "Fib 38.2%", "line3d", "#ffcc00", "3d", 1)
plot3d(fib50, "Fib 50%", "line3d", "#b48cff", "3d", 2)
plot3d(fib618, "Fib 61.8%", "line3d", "#22cc88", "3d", 3)

fastLen = input(10, "Fast Vol Length", 2, 30, 1)
medLen = input(30, "Medium Vol Length", 5, 60, 1)
slowLen = input(60, "Slow Vol Length", 10, 120, 1)
skewLen = input(60, "Skew Range Length", 10, 120, 1)
compLb = input(60, "Compression Lookback", 10, 120, 1)
bullLvl = input(0.1, "Skew Bull Level", -0.5, 0.5, 0.01)
bearLvl = input(-0.1, "Skew Bear Level", -0.5, 0.5, 0.01)

r = (close - close[1]) / (close[1] + 0.000000001)
rvFast = stdev(r, fastLen) * sqrt(10)
rvMed = stdev(r, medLen) * sqrt(30)
rvSlow = stdev(r, slowLen) * sqrt(60)
hiR = highest(high, skewLen)
loR = lowest(low, skewLen)
rng = hiR - loR
posRaw = (close - loR) / (rng + 0.000000001)
pos = rng > 0 ? posRaw : 0.5
skew = pos - 0.5
spreadFS = rvFast - rvSlow
spreadMS = rvMed - rvSlow
termAvg = (rvFast + rvMed + rvSlow) / 3
lowFast = lowest(rvFast, compLb)
comp = rvFast <= lowFast and rvFast < rvMed and rvFast < rvSlow
upFast = rvFast > rvFast[1]
spreadUp = spreadFS > spreadFS[1]

var lastCompBar = -1000
var lastSigBar = -1000

recentComp = bar_index - lastCompBar <= 3
expand = upFast and spreadUp and recentComp
crossUpBull = skew > bullLvl and skew[1] <= bullLvl
crossDnBear = skew < bearLvl and skew[1] >= bearLvl
buyRaw = expand and crossUpBull
sellRaw = expand and crossDnBear
buySig = buyRaw and bar_index - lastSigBar > 5
sellSig = sellRaw and bar_index - lastSigBar > 5

if comp {
  lastCompBar := bar_index
}
if buySig {
  lastSigBar := bar_index
}
if sellSig {
  lastSigBar := bar_index
}
if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}

plot(spreadFS, "Fast-Slow Spread", "#ffcc33", 2, "separate")
plot(spreadMS, "Med-Slow Spread", "#33aaff", 1, "separate")
plot(skew, "Skew", "#22cc88", 2, "separate")
hline(0, "#888888", "separate")
hline(bullLvl, "#22cc88", "separate")
hline(bearLvl, "#ff4477", "separate")
plot3d(termAvg, "Term Manifold", "manifold", "#22cc88", "separate", 0)
plot3d(rvFast, "Fast Spine", "ribbon", "#ffcc33", "separate", 1)
plot3d(expand ? rvFast : 0, "Expansion Impulse", "bars3d", "#ff4477", "separate", 2)

ch1 = input(20, "Ch1 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch2 = input(40, "Ch2 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch3 = input(60, "Ch3 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch4 = input(80, "Ch4 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch5 = input(100, "Ch5 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
baseThickness = input(1, "Base Thickness", 1, 5, 1)
thicknessFactor = input(0.05, "Thickness Factor", 0.01, 0.2, 0.01)
buyThreshold = input(70, "Buy Threshold", 50, 100, 1)
sellThreshold = input(30, "Sell Threshold", 0, 50, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

drift = close - open
rng = high - low
mom = close - close[1]
vMod = (volume - volume[1]) / (volume + 1) * 10
hiMod = high - open
loMod = close - low

c1raw = ch1 + drift * 2.0 + mom + vMod * 0.3
c2raw = ch2 + hiMod * 1.5 + drift * 0.5 + vMod * 0.2
c3raw = ch3 + loMod * 1.2 + mom * 0.8 + rng * 0.5
c4raw = ch4 + rng * 1.0 + drift * 1.0 + mom * 0.5
c5raw = ch5 + drift * 2.0 + hiMod * 0.5 + vMod * 0.4

c1v = c1raw > 100 ? 100 : c1raw < 0 ? 0 : c1raw
c2v = c2raw > 100 ? 100 : c2raw < 0 ? 0 : c2raw
c3v = c3raw > 100 ? 100 : c3raw < 0 ? 0 : c3raw
c4v = c4raw > 100 ? 100 : c4raw < 0 ? 0 : c4raw
c5v = c5raw > 100 ? 100 : c5raw < 0 ? 0 : c5raw
h1 = c1v * 1.0
h2 = c2v * 1.0
h3 = c3v * 1.0
h4 = c4v * 1.0
h5 = c5v * 1.0
Avg = (c1v + c2v + c3v + c4v + c5v) / 5
Tval = baseThickness + thicknessFactor * Avg
splineTop = (h1 + h2 + h3 + h4 + h5) / 5 + (h5 - h1) / 10
avgColor = Avg > buyThreshold ? "#22cc88" : Avg < sellThreshold ? "#ff4477" : "#33aaff"
buySig = crossover(Avg, buyThreshold) and c5v > c1v
sellSig = crossunder(Avg, sellThreshold) and c5v < c1v

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}

if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}

plot(c1v, "Ch1", "#ff5555", 1, "separate")
plot(c2v, "Ch2", "#ffaa00", 1, "separate")
plot(c3v, "Ch3", "#33aaff", 1, "separate")
plot(c4v, "Ch4", "#9955ff", 1, "separate")
plot(c5v, "Ch5", "#22cc88", 1, "separate")
plot(Avg, "Array Avg", "#ffffff", 2, "separate")
plot(Tval, "Spline Thickness", "#ffdd00", 1, "separate")
hline(buyThreshold, "#22cc88", "separate")
hline(sellThreshold, "#ff4477", "separate")
plot3d(h1, "Cyl Ch1", "bars3d", "#ff5555", "separate", 0)
plot3d(h2, "Cyl Ch2", "bars3d", "#ffaa00", "separate", 1)
plot3d(h3, "Cyl Ch3", "bars3d", "#33aaff", "separate", 2)
plot3d(h4, "Cyl Ch4", "bars3d", "#9955ff", "separate", 3)
plot3d(h5, "Cyl Ch5", "bars3d", "#22cc88", "separate", 4)
plot3d(splineTop, "Spline Tops", "ribbon", "#22cc88", "separate", 5)

wind_direction_vector_x = input(1.0, "Wind Dir Vector X", -5.0, 5.0, 0.1)
wind_direction_vector_y = input(0.0, "Wind Dir Vector Y", -5.0, 5.0, 0.1)
wind_direction_vector_z = input(0.0, "Wind Dir Vector Z", -5.0, 5.0, 0.1)
wind_speed_knots = input(10.0, "Wind Speed Knots", 0.0, 100.0, 0.5)
base_tail_length = input(1.0, "Base Tail Length", 0.2, 5.0, 0.1)
length_factor = input(0.1, "Length Factor", 0.0, 1.0, 0.01)
min_speed_knots = input(0.0, "Min Speed Knots", 0.0, 50.0, 1.0)
max_speed_knots = input(50.0, "Max Speed Knots", 10.0, 100.0, 1.0)
high_wind_alert_knots = input(35.0, "High Wind Alert Knots", 5.0, 80.0, 1.0)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

driftX = (close - open) / (close + 0.000000001)
driftY = (high - low) / (close + 0.000000001)
driftZ = (close - close[1]) / (close + 0.000000001)
gustMod = abs(close - open) / (close + 0.000000001) * 100.0

wx = wind_direction_vector_x + driftX * 2.0
wy = wind_direction_vector_y + driftY * 2.0
wz = wind_direction_vector_z + driftZ * 5.0
eff_speed = wind_speed_knots + gustMod

mag = sqrt(wx * wx + wy * wy + wz * wz)
safeMag = mag < 0.000000001 ? 1.0 : mag
ux = wx / safeMag
uy = wy / safeMag
uzraw = wz / safeMag
uz = uzraw > 1.0 ? 1.0 : uzraw < -1.0 ? -1.0 : uzraw

yawRad = atan2(wy, wx)
pitchRad = asin(uz)
rollRad = atan2(wy, wx)
yawDeg = yawRad * 57.29578
pitchDeg = pitchRad * 57.29578
rollDeg = rollRad * 57.29578

tailLen = base_tail_length + length_factor * eff_speed
span = max_speed_knots - min_speed_knots + 0.000000001
speedRaw = (eff_speed - min_speed_knots) / span
speed_norm = speedRaw < 0.0 ? 0.0 : speedRaw > 1.0 ? 1.0 : speedRaw

gradColor = speed_norm < 0.25 ? "#2288ff" : speed_norm < 0.5 ? "#55aaff" : speed_norm < 0.75 ? "#ff9944" : "#ff6600"
coneSizeRaw = tailLen * markerSize
coneSize = coneSizeRaw < 0.2 ? 0.2 : coneSizeRaw > 3.0 ? 3.0 : coneSizeRaw

var priorYaw = 0.0
var priorPitch = 0.0
var lastDirBar = 0
usePrior = mag < 0.000000001
yawUse = usePrior ? priorYaw : yawDeg
pitchUse = usePrior ? priorPitch : pitchDeg
yawChg = abs(yawUse - yawUse[1])
pitchChg = abs(pitchUse - pitchUse[1])

buySig = eff_speed > high_wind_alert_knots and eff_speed[1] <= high_wind_alert_knots
sellSig = eff_speed < high_wind_alert_knots and eff_speed[1] >= high_wind_alert_knots
dirShiftRaw = (yawChg > 30.0 or pitchChg > 30.0) and eff_speed > 15.0
dirShiftSig = dirShiftRaw and (bar_index - lastDirBar > 5)

if usePrior {
} else {
    priorYaw := yawDeg
    priorPitch := pitchDeg
}
if dirShiftSig {
    lastDirBar := bar_index
}

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "HighWind", "triangleup", "#ff8800")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "WindDrop", "triangledown", "#2288ff")
}
if dirShiftSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Shift", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}

if buySig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, eff_speed, "HighWind", "coneup", "#ff8800", coneSize, 0, "separate", pitchUse, yawUse, rollDeg)
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, eff_speed, "WindDrop", "conedown", "#2288ff", coneSize, 1, "separate", pitchUse, yawUse, rollDeg)
}
if dirShiftSig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, eff_speed, "Shift", "diamond", "#ff4477", coneSize, 2, "separate", pitchUse, yawUse, rollDeg)
}
if buySig {
    label3d(bar_index, eff_speed, "HIGH WIND", "#ff8800", 1, 0, "separate")
}

arrow.new(bar_index - 8, eff_speed - uz * tailLen, bar_index, eff_speed + uz * tailLen, gradColor, 2, "windvec")

plot(eff_speed, "Wind Speed kn", "#ff8800", 2, "separate")
plot(tailLen, "Tail Length", "#2288ff", 1, "separate")
plot3d(eff_speed, "Wind Speed", "trail", "#ff8800", "separate", 0)
plot3d(tailLen, "Tail Length", "line3d", "#2288ff", "separate", 1)
